independence.claim_evaluated: the admissible records come from 1 distinct registered operator(s): Example Operator A AG
independence.conclusion: one operator only (Example Operator A AG): its records count as one source, so there is no independent corroboration
independence.grouping_rule: Records count towards independence only if admissible (signed by a registered, non-revoked key over this artifact). All keys of one registry operator count as one source (CANON-SIG-011), and at most one record counts per (verifier identity, provenance) (CANON-IND-004).
independence.limits: The verifier registry is trusted input. Signature checks and grouping by operator cannot detect misrepresented common control or collusion between registered operators; that requires the evidence referenced below, evaluated outside the signature check (docs/sybil-design.md).
